about.title: About {Me}
about.lead: Full Stack Developer working on international projects, moving naturally between back-end and front-end with C#/.NET, Java, Spring Boot, React, Next.js and Angular.
paragraphs: I currently build solutions for an architect client based in Madrid (Spain) and have worked on projects with companies such as Zühlke, BASF and SoftwareOne — delivering everything from Design Systems and micro frontends to microservices and RESTful APIs built on SOLID and Clean Architecture.

I have solid experience with complex integrations: messaging with Kafka and RabbitMQ, payment webhooks (Stripe, Pagar.me), MuleSoft, Dynamics CRM and Salesforce, plus cloud with Azure, AWS, Kubernetes and OpenShift — always focused on performance, quality and best practices.
I'm currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Information Systems at UNEX, expected to graduate in 2026.

ffsystem.descricao: Complete ERP/POS system for retail management.
ffsystem.descricaoLonga: FFSystem is a complete ERP/POS ecosystem focused on retail automation and efficient management for small and medium-sized businesses. It brings together inventory, sales, customers and finance in an intuitive interface, backed by a robust Spring Boot back-end and JWT-authenticated REST APIs.
ffsystem.problema: Local businesses lacked centralized control over inventory and sales, relying on manual methods prone to errors and loss of financial data.
ffsystem.solucao: I built an integrated platform that automates cash flow, tracks inventory in real time and generates analytical reports for decision-making.
ffsystem.desafios: Real-time inventory synchronization and high-performance generation of complex reports.
ffsystem.aprendizados: Deeper knowledge of Spring Boot architecture, JWT authentication and design patterns for management systems.
ffsystem.resultados: Estimated 30% reduction in time users spend on administrative tasks.
ffsystem.arquitetura: Layered architecture with a React front-end, a Java Spring Boot back-end exposing REST APIs and a PostgreSQL relational database.

metricas.tempo: less time spent on administrative tasks

europa-pra-vc.descricao: International platform for immigration and international trade services.
europa-pra-vc.descricaoLonga: International platform for immigration and international trade services, featuring a marketplace, admin dashboard and integration across multiple APIs. Built on a scalable architecture with a .NET back-end and a React front-end.
europa-pra-vc.problema: The complexity of immigration and international trade services called for a single, scalable platform integrated with several external services.
europa-pra-vc.solucao: A complete platform with marketplace, order management, user management and API integrations, backed by a scalable architecture.
europa-pra-vc.desafios: Managing complex state and reliably integrating with multiple external service providers.
europa-pra-vc.aprendizados: Hands-on experience integrating third-party APIs and designing scalable architectures in .NET.
europa-pra-vc.resultados: Growth of the user base and operational stability at international scale.
europa-pra-vc.arquitetura: .NET back-end with clean architecture exposing REST APIs, React front-end and PostgreSQL database.

grupo-mais-saude.descricao: Institutional website for a medical clinic.
grupo-mais-saude.descricaoLonga: Institutional website for a medical clinic, focused on responsive design, SEO, performance and reusable components to make health information easier for patients to access.
grupo-mais-saude.problema: Patients struggled to quickly and easily find information about the clinic's specialties and services.
grupo-mais-saude.solucao: An intuitive, responsive institutional interface optimized for SEO and performance, built with reusable components.
grupo-mais-saude.desafios: Ensuring accessibility and excellent web performance (Core Web Vitals) on a content-rich website.
grupo-mais-saude.aprendizados: Strong focus on technical SEO, performance and component reuse.
grupo-mais-saude.resultados: Longer time on site and a better browsing experience for patients.
grupo-mais-saude.arquitetura: Modular React front-end focused on component reuse, SEO and performance.

marianne-soares-nutri.descricao: Institutional website for a clinical and functional nutritionist.
marianne-soares-nutri.descricaoLonga: Institutional website for nutritionist Marianne Soares Machado, based in Feira de Santana (Bahia, Brazil). It presents her areas of practice, the Reset Metabólico™ program, how consultations work, reviews and an FAQ, with direct WhatsApp booking for in-person and online appointments.
marianne-soares-nutri.problema: The professional needed her own online presence that conveyed credibility, ranked in local searches and turned visitors into bookings.
marianne-soares-nutri.solucao: A lightweight, responsive website with local SEO, structured data for Google and calls to action that open WhatsApp with pre-filled messages for each type of appointment.
marianne-soares-nutri.desafios: Achieving fast loading with prominent photos and strong local search visibility without relying on a framework.
marianne-soares-nutri.aprendizados: Technical SEO for local businesses (schema.org, Open Graph) and image optimization with srcset and preload.
marianne-soares-nutri.resultados: A dedicated patient acquisition channel, with bookings routed to WhatsApp.
marianne-soares-nutri.arquitetura: Static website built with plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript, with responsive WebP images, optimized fonts and hosted on Vercel.
